content: 'Itsahaki kemɨtiunuiwaxɨ
Yawé kemainekai, Tsara 'aixɨa kaniuyurieni, katinaye'atɨani kemɨrehɨawekai.
Tsara kaniutihukata 'Apɨrahami nu'ayatɨme kanayexeiya 'ukiratsitɨkaku. Kakaɨyari kepauka mainekai 'ana katiniunake.
'Apɨrahami yuniwe 'Itsahaki katiniuterɨwa, Tsara hamatɨa memeyexei.
'Apɨrahami xitekiya 'inɨariyari 'Itsahaki kaniuwewirieni 'atahaika tukari 'anukayaku, Kakaɨyari kemɨtita'aitɨa.
Xeitsienituyari wiyari kanexeiyakaitɨni 'Apɨrahami kepauka 'Itsahaki mutinuiwaxɨ.
Hikɨ Tsara mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: «Kakaɨyari nemutanawenikɨ yapɨnetiupitɨa, yaxeikɨata kemɨ'ane memɨtehetimani meputinaweni nehamatɨa.
Matsi nixewitɨ 'Apɨrahami mɨpaɨ pɨkarehɨawekai kename ne tɨɨri newatitsitsitɨanikekai, matsi hikɨ nunutsi nepayexei nu'ayatɨme 'ukiratsitɨkaku».
Hakari meta 'Itsimaheri kememɨtehayenɨ'arie
Nunutsi 'Itsahaki kaniutawere, tsitsieya mekaniku'eiritsitɨani. Mɨkɨ tukaritsie 'Apɨrahami 'ixɨarari kaniuwewieni yuniwe hetsiemieme.
'Ana Tsara mɨpaɨ katinetimani 'Itsahaki 'ekipitutanaka Hakari nu'aya 'Apɨrahami hamatɨa meyexeiyakai kaninanaimakaitɨni 'i'atsetɨ.

Hikɨ 'ayumieme Tsara 'Apɨrahami mɨpaɨ katiniutahɨawe: —Kenanunɨ'a ti'a'uximayatsiriwame yuniwemakame, neniwe 'Itsahaki tita pemɨtiyetuirieni 'apiini, mɨkɨ mana heitserie pɨkahexeiyani ti'a'uximayatsiriwame nu'aya.
Kepauka 'Apɨrahami mɨyamɨtiutahɨawarie, kaniuyukahiwerieni nu'aya mɨhɨkɨtɨkaikɨ Hakari hetsiemieme.
Peru Kakaɨyari 'Apɨrahami mɨpaɨ katiniutahɨawe: «Pepɨka'a'iyaritɨaka nunutsikɨ meta maamaya ti'uximayatamekɨ. Tsara kemerahɨawe yaketineuyuri, 'anuiwarima 'Itsahaki hetsie pɨta mekaniyekɨnikuni.
Meta ti'uximayatame nu'aya nuiwari mariweme nepayeitɨani, 'aniwe mɨhɨkɨkɨ».

'Uxa'arieka, ximeripaitɨ 'Apɨrahami nanukukeni, paa, nawi haa 'uyemakame Hakari naiparieyatsie nekawirieni. Hikɨta nu'aya kaniyetuirieni, meta kaniwarutateutɨani. Hakari kanayeyani, mekaniuhukaitɨni me'u'erietɨ makumawetsie Weritsewa mɨrakutewatsie.
Kepauka yuhaa memayexɨ nawita mɨyemakai, Hakari yuniwe 'ɨtsitɨa 'itiyeka,
kaneyani yateewa mana 'ukaitɨ kaniutitsɨatɨyani maamaya, temaikɨ kaxeiyamɨtɨ kepauka mɨmɨnikekai.

Hikɨ Kakaɨyari temaikɨ tsuarieya kaniu'enieni, Hakari kaniutahɨawe muyuawitsie paitɨ niuki tuayame Kakaɨyari hetsiemieme mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: «Hakari mɨpaɨ pepɨkayɨaneni. Pepɨkamaka, Kakaɨyari temaikɨ tsuarieya kaniu'enieni.
Xeiya kenemie hetsɨana keneuwitɨximeni pepɨka'itatuayani, ne mɨkɨ nuiwarieya mariweme nekanayeitɨamɨkɨ».
Hikɨ Kakaɨyari Hakari haixa kaniuxeitsitɨani. 'Anari yapauka 'utihanɨka nawi kɨxauriyaritsie temaikɨ kaniuharitɨani.
Hikɨ Kakaɨyari temaikɨ hamatɨa kaniuyeikakaitɨni, mɨkɨ kaniwerekaitɨni makumawetsie kaniukateitɨni, tupi 'ɨrɨkɨ kwinimieme timɨiwetɨ kanayani.
Parani mɨrakutewatsie kaniukateitɨni makumawetsie, maamaya 'ekipitutanaka kaniwitɨtɨani.
'Apɨrahami meta 'Awimereki tɨratu kemɨte'uwewi

'Ana 'Awimereki 'Apɨrahami hetsɨa kaninuani, Pikuuri titewatɨ kaneteɨtakaitɨni kuyaximama wa'ukiyari, mɨpaɨ 'Apɨrahami katiniutahɨawe: —Mɨpaɨ tepɨtemate, Kakaɨyari waɨkawa pɨmatsiparewie naime kepemɨtiyuriene.

'Ayumieme, yakenetineutahɨawi Kakaɨyari hɨxie, hikɨ kwitɨwa, kename pekaneti'itaiyani meta neniwema yaxeikɨa nenuiwarima, yakeneutayɨki kename yaxeikɨa penetixeiyani kenemɨmatixeiya, meta yunaime teɨteri 'ikɨ kwieyaritsie kiekatari pemanuyeika 'ateewa kiekame hepaɨ.
'Apɨrahami mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: —Huu, yanepɨra'eriwa.
Peru 'Apɨrahami 'Awimereki katiniutaxatɨani putsu hepaɨtsita, mɨkɨ teɨterimama meminawairiekaikɨ.
'Awimereki mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: —Nematsi mɨpaɨ nepɨkatimaikai, 'ekɨtsɨ mɨpaɨ penerahɨaweka, ne 'atsinepɨkatimate kemɨ'ane mɨyamɨtiuyuri.
Hikɨ 'Apɨrahami wakaitsixi kaniwarutiwiya muxatsi meta, 'Awimereki kaniumini, mɨkɨ tukaritsie yuhutatɨ tɨratu mekaniuwewieni.
Peru 'Apɨrahami 'atahutame muxatsi 'ukarawetsixi kaniwarayehapani yukuraruta,
'Awimereki 'Apɨrahami mɨpaɨ katiniuta'iwawiya: —¿Titayari petiwarayehapana mɨkɨ 'atahutame muxatsi?
'Apɨrahami mɨpaɨ katinita'eiya: —'Ikɨ 'atahuta muxatsi 'ukari keniwarutanaki'eri. Matsi mɨpaɨ mɨtimatsiɨkɨnikɨ kename ne putsu ne'utawewi.
'Ayumieme mana Weritsewa pɨtiuterɨwarie, mana tɨratu memuwewikɨ yuhutatɨ.
Hikɨ tɨratu me'uwewiekari Weritsewa, 'Awimereki Pikuuri matɨa kuyaxi wa'ukiyari piritsiteutsixi yukwieyaritsie mekanakunuaxɨani.
Hikɨ mana Weritsewa, 'Apɨrahami tamaritsiku titewakame kaniuka'eni, mɨkɨtɨa Yawé Kakaɨyari 'atsimɨkayɨwe kaniutahɨawekaitɨni.
Mɨixa wiyari 'Apɨrahami kaniutihuni piritsiteutsixi wakwieyaritsie 'ukaitɨ.

footnotes.text: Kɨriyekutsixi waniukikɨ 'Itsahaki. Peru hepɨrayutsixi waniukikɨ pɨkahexaxata.
Hepɨrayukɨ kaneyani yateewa, yatɨni tupikɨ tiutamɨyɨ 'ɨrɨ keteewa mukawautsepanuyɨne.
